about.title: About me
about.lead: I’m Grégoire Fortuné, currently studying computer science at the IUT of Aubière (France).
about.description: A few highlights to understand who I am and what drives my work.

paragraphs: I’m in my first year of the B.U.T Informatique program where I build strong fundamentals in algorithms, web development, and software design.
The curriculum blends core CS topics (programming, databases, networking) with transversal skills such as communication, project management, and finance, giving me a broader view of the job.
I’m looking for a 10-week internship starting May 2026 to apply this knowledge within a professional team and keep learning by doing.

items.title: CineRentPro
items.summary: Showcase site for a fictional company renting and refurbishing multimedia equipment.

segments.title: Context
segments.text: For SAE 1.06 we had to present CineRent Pro, a fictional company operating across Europe with a focus on renting and refurbishing gear.

segments.title: Goals
items: Apply core HTML/CSS to structure a multi-section website.
Organize information: company intro, SWOT analysis, economic and environmental data.
Build a clear navigation with anchor links and responsive design.
Showcase team collaboration by splitting content writing, design, and integration.

segments.title: What I delivered
items: Wrote the copy: presentation, SWOT, economic and ecological metrics.
Structured the HTML sections (Introduction, Assets, Environment, Economy).
Styled the pages with CSS, Font Awesome, and responsive tweaks.
Added imagery illustrating the logo, data centers, refurbishment process.
Implemented a fixed navigation bar with anchor links.
Coordinated the team to align code, design, and messaging.

segments.title: Result
segments.text: A complete showcase site that reflects the company’s identity. We scored 12/20 (class average 10.8/20, top grade 14.5/20) while highlighting our web and strategic skills.

items.title: Gen3DMap
items.summary: Building an AI able to generate playable, customizable 3D maps automatically.

segments.title: Context
segments.text: Authoring 3D maps manually is time-consuming and expensive. The idea is to automate it without sacrificing variety, gameplay, or visual coherence.

segments.title: Objective
segments.text: Design an AI/procedural system that produces parameterized terrains and exports them to Unity or Unreal.

items.title: Research & analysis
details: Studying Perlin noise, Voronoï, 3D GANs, L-systems, etc.
Reviewing famous procedural engines (Minecraft, No Man’s Sky, …).

items.title: Data preparation
details: Annotating key areas: POIs, playable zones, resources.

items.title: AI modeling
details: Experimenting with 3D GANs or enhanced procedural generation.
Adding control parameters: density, biomes, topography.

items.title: Visualization & integration
details: Exporting meshes or heightmaps for Unity.
Realtime display with a navigation camera.
Simple UI to tweak and test parameters.
